t.zh: 「或者」也可以这样定义：「A 或者 B」就是「对任何一句话 R，只要从 A 推得出 R、从 B 也推得出 R，就有 R」，写成 ∀R. (A → R) → ((B → R) → R)。
t.en: “Or” can be defined the same way: “A or B” is “for every sentence R, if R follows from A and R follows from B, then R”, written ∀R. (A → R) → ((B → R) → R).

after.zh: 声明给出引入规则，由它生成消去规则；这样的定义写下的是消去规则，引入规则要从它证出来。两条路得到的规则一样。
after.en: A declaration gives the intro rules and the elimination rule is made from them; a definition like this writes down the elimination rule, and the intro rules are proved from it. Both roads give the same rules.

hint.zh: 任取框取 R；框里的目标有两层「若…则…」。
hint.en: A for-any box takes R; inside, the goal has two layers of “if … then …”.

hint.zh: 要的结论是 C：把 R 换成 C，再把两个办法依次交给它。
hint.en: The conclusion wanted is C: put C in for R, then hand it the two moves in turn.
